meta.comment: Phase-3 spirit root ladder (ROADMAP 'Spirit Roots'). The canonical 10-type DESIGN.md progression (No Root → Chaos), worst→best: ids, names and tier positions follow DESIGN.md 'Spirit Roots' exactly. Spirit Roots are the primary cultivation affinity — they determine cultivation speed (speedMultiplier feeds cultivation.spiritRootMultiplier in the future SpiritRootSystem), elemental affinity (elements: one canonical example element per element-bearing root — a placeholder slot for the future elemental-affinity system, no consumer yet), future techniques, sect and Dao compatibility (attributes). weight is the weighted-roll weight for the Spirit Root Roll during character generation — rarer/better roots roll less often (tuning, not lore). The 'unawakened' fresh-game state is deliberately NOT in this table (it lives in game-state at multiplier 1). All curves are monotonic placeholder tuning — Phase 10 Balancing retunes them.

definitions.name: No Root
definitions.description: A cultivator without an elemental affinity.

definitions.name: Pseudo Root
definitions.description: A faint elemental trace, too weak to cultivate properly.

definitions.name: Mixed Root
definitions.description: Several weak elemental affinities blended together.

definitions.name: Three Element
definitions.description: Three balanced elemental affinities within a single root.

definitions.name: Dual Element
definitions.description: Two complementary elemental affinities within a single root.

definitions.name: Mutated
definitions.description: An elemental affinity mutated beyond its original form.

definitions.name: Heavenly
definitions.description: An exceptionally pure and powerful elemental affinity.

definitions.name: Divine
definitions.description: A divine-grade elemental affinity of remarkable potential.

definitions.name: Chaos
definitions.description: An affinity that echoes primordial chaos itself.
